derivation: feminine of H3715 (כְּפִיר); the village (always with the art.);

occurrences.text: And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath–jearim.
And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,
The children of Kirjath–arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty and three.
The men of Kirjath–jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty and three.
